<figure class="not-prose my-12 mt-0"><div class="bg-card overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex aspect-video items-center justify-center px-10"><img alt="xAI and El Salvador logos" loading="lazy" width="331" height="120" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="w-full sm:w-[500px] invert dark:invert-0" style="color:transparent" src="/_next/static/media/el-salvador-banner.03kqq9365tu8e.svg?dpl=f5496767b0e65480015db0d425ea15a2380ba3ef"/></div></figure>
<p>Today, xAI is thrilled to announce a groundbreaking partnership with the Government of El Salvador to launch the world&#x27;s first nationwide AI-powered education program. Over the next two years, we&#x27;ll deploy Grok across more than 5,000 public schools, delivering personalized learning to over one million students and empowering thousands of teachers as collaborative partners in education.</p>
<p>This initiative will create adaptive, curriculum-aligned tutoring that adjusts to each student&#x27;s pace, preferences, and mastery level—ensuring every child, from urban centers to rural communities, receives world-class education tailored to their needs. By co-developing this system with El Salvador, we&#x27;ll generate new methodologies, datasets, and frameworks to guide responsible AI use in classrooms globally, with a focus on local contexts, safety, and human-centered impact.</p>
<p>At xAI, our mission is to advance scientific discovery and deepen our collective understanding of the universe. This partnership embodies that purpose by harnessing Grok&#x27;s frontier capabilities to accelerate learning at scale, bridging educational gaps, and fostering innovation that benefits humanity. It&#x27;s a step toward making advanced AI accessible to all, reimagining how nations build knowledge for generations to come.</p>
<p>As President Nayib Bukele said:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>El Salvador doesn&#x27;t just wait for the future to happen; we build it. From establishing the global standard in security to now pioneering AI-driven education, El Salvador proves that nations can leapfrog directly to the top through bold policy and strategic vision. With xAI as the leader in frontier models and El Salvador as a testbed for innovation, this partnership is destined to deliver something rather extraordinary for all of humanity.</p>
</blockquote>
<p>As Elon said:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>By partnering with President Bukele to bring Grok to every student in El Salvador, we’re putting the most advanced AI directly in the hands of an entire generation. El Salvador isn’t waiting for the future of education — they’re building it with xAI.</p>
</blockquote>
<p>We&#x27;re genuinely excited to work hand-in-hand with El Salvador to unlock the full potential of AI in education and inspire global change.</p>
<p>For governments interested in transformative projects, please reach out to <a href="mailto:global-government@x.ai">global-government@x.ai</a>.</p>
<p>Onward.</p>
